description:
Personal finance and investing for beginners, explained simply. The Boring Rich Club shows regular Americans how to build wealth the boring way: budgeting, an emergency fund, paying off credit card debt, your 401(k) match, a Roth IRA and low-cost index funds. Get rich slowly. On purpose.

No stock tips. No crypto pumps. No get-rich-quick. Just the steps that actually work, in the right order, in short animated videos.

What you'll learn:
• How to start investing from $0
• 401(k) match, Roth IRA and HSA basics
• Index funds and ETFs for beginners
• How to pay off credit card debt
• Budgeting and emergency funds
• Money mistakes that keep people broke
• Scam red flags and "guaranteed return" traps

New videos every day: full guides at 3 PM ET, Shorts at 7 PM ET. Subscribe and start with the "Start Here: Investing From $0" playlist.

📌 Educational content only. Not financial advice. Do your own research or talk to a licensed professional.
